title: Severe cardinality error from stale statistics
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cardinality_test (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT) WITH (autovacuum_enabled = false);
INSERT INTO cardinality_test (id, status, payload) SELECT g, 'normal', md5(g::text) FROM generate_series(1, 100000) AS g;
UPDATE cardinality_test SET status = 'hot' WHERE id <= 50000;
description: Planner statistics describe status as 100% normal, but half the rows have changed to hot after ANALYZE. SafeDBA should diagnose stale statistics and propose ANALYZE_TABLE rather than an index or query rewrite.
